results.device_description: REVIAN RED is a non-invasive, hands-free device indicated to treat androgenetic alopecia in both men and women. It is operated via a mobile application to promote hair growth using Modulated Light Therapy (MLT) for a recommended 10-minute daily treatment. REVIAN RED is designed as an over-the-counter (OTC) home-based device to treat the entire scalp area of the user and is controlled via a wireless Bluetooth connection to a mobile application operating on a wireless device.
